name: RT-X (RT-1-X / RT-2-X)
summary: Retraining the RT architectures on the pooled Open X-Embodiment corpus (60 datasets, 22 embodiments, 30+ labs) produced RT-1-X and RT-2-X. RT-1-X outperformed the original single-dataset specialist policies on 5 of 6 evaluated lab setups by roughly 50% on average, and RT-2-X showed skills that only appeared once other robots' data was in the mix.
innovation: Demonstrated positive cross-embodiment transfer at scale: pooled training beat per-robot specialists.
A shared end-effector action space that made wildly different arms trainable in one batch.
matters: Justified the open-data pooling effort every open VLA now trains on.
limits: Transfer benefits concentrated in low-data regimes; large in-domain datasets still won.
lineage: The RT architectures re-trained on the Open X-Embodiment pool.
